$description: The split intro. Times in seconds from the first frame; lengths in units of the 1280x720 frame the intro is composed on, whatever size it is rendered at. Every number is tuned, so each one has an entry in brand/tokens/provenance.json and gates/check-provenance.mjs refuses one that moves without a new answer.

scale.$description: Frame pixels per ninth once the lockup has settled.

from.$description: Mark size at the first frame, in frame pixels per ninth.

to.$description: Mark size when the zoom ends and it waits for the stamp.

fade.$description: The outline fades once the fill has covered it.

whiten.$description: The fill turns from pink to white.

ripple.$description: Height of the fill's surface wave at the start of the rise, in ninths; it flattens as the fill rises.

at.$description: The stamp pulse, once the mark is white. The sound's hit lands here.

length.$description: How long the pulse takes to grow and fade.

grow.$description: How far the pulse grows, as a share of the mark's size.

settle.$description: The mark shrinks into its place in the split lockup.

at.$description: WAVING and EYE start sliding out from under the mark.

travel.$description: How far the type slides, in frame pixels.

edge.$description: Width of the pink light edge on the slide, in frame pixels.

fade.$description: Fade to the end colour; the last 0.2 s are solid.
